name: Flanking
description: When you and one or more allies are engaged with the same foe, each of you gains +1d to attack rolls against that foe.

improvements.name: Team Strike
improvements.description: You and flanking allies also take +1d to damage rolls against the flanked foe.

improvements.name: Topple
improvements.description: When you or a flanking ally lands a hit with a melee attack, one of you other than the attacker may roll Strength vs Dexterity against that foe. If you win the roll, the foe is knocked prone.
